entwurf.thema: ChatGPT agents for small business automation

teile.text: Managing a small business is a total paper-clogged nightmare.
teile.szene: A middle-aged man in a messy office looking shocked and overwhelmed by mountains of physical paperwork and glowing monitor light, painted open-world game poster style.

teile.text: You can build agents to handle the mess.
teile.szene: The channel presenter with black hair and glowing cyan glasses wearing a black leather jacket, standing in a vibrant neon-lit street looking confident.

teile.text: Use the Responses API to generate structured JSON data.
Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: The presenter in the leather jacket and cyan glasses gesturing toward floating digital heart and bookmark icons in a cinematic urban setting.

teile.text: Reasoning models excel at understanding complex tasks.
gpt-6-astra input costs ten dollars per million tokens.

teile.szene: The same business owner from the first scene now looking relaxed and happy, drinking coffee in a clean, high-tech, and perfectly organized office, vibrant painted style.

entwurf.beschreibung: Stop the business chaos by building ChatGPT agents. Learn to use the Responses API for structured data and understand the costs and capabilities of Reasoning models like GPT-6 Astra for complex multi-step planning tasks.
